name: Jack Hobbs
source:
[i]"Hahaha, come on, Matchstick, try to get it back! Look over here!!"[/i]

A 4th year student and Michael's roommate, who cohabitates with him in a six-person dorm room. He's cynical and unpleasant. He's specifically mean towards Cecil for some reason, calling him Matchstick (due to his skinny body and round head) at every chance he gets and picking on him in other ways. He also treats Benjamin, their chubby roommate, like a lackey. Despite that, he doesn't seem like a bad person at heart. 

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
